label: B25-CANDIDATE-LIVE-IDENTITY-CONTRACT
title: Review the candidate design-hash observability failure and define a fail-closed live identity contract
dependency_exception: T-031 hardware execution is terminal and final board state is independently proven golden; its documentation correction may complete in parallel with this read-only audit.
scope: Determine whether T-031 failed because the candidate was not configured or because a preserved/custom jtagserver could not expose a fresh design hash. Compare T-021's successful programming/terminal identity chain and T-031 raw programmer/enumeration logs, then define a fail-closed replacement identity contract for exactly one new board attempt. Do not touch GamePC or hardware.

acceptance.historical_contract: Prove from T-021 raw program result/script/log whether its accepted candidate configuration required a post-program candidate design hash, and identify the exact evidence that bridged SOF identity to LCVEX BOOT/READY.
acceptance.T031_transactions: Inventory every T-031 candidate/golden programmer invocation and distinguish quartus_pgm transaction success from wrapper identity-gate failure. Record exact paths, stdout hashes, checksums, JTAG IDs and retry protocol deviations.
acceptance.observability: Compare owned-server and preserved-standard jtagconfig output before/after programming. Determine what can and cannot be concluded from the stale golden hash, missing owned hash and changed node set; do not infer an undocumented hardware fact.
acceptance.replacement_contract: Either require a concrete supported method that can prove the live candidate hash before terminal, or define a strict compound identity chain: exact SHA-bound SOF and programmer command/checksum/JTAG-ID/config success, followed by candidate-unique LCVEX25 BOOT/READY/RXDBG in the first live terminal before any input. Missing startup identity must immediately fail and restore golden. Standard-server cached design hash is diagnostic only, never silently ignored.
acceptance.functional_gate: The replacement must retain all original paced ?/p/d/Z, RXPATH, RXCPU, RXDBG and mandatory golden-restoration requirements. It must authorize only one additional candidate configuration and one golden restoration, with no debug retries inside the board task.
acceptance.decision: State whether a new board attempt is justified without calling the correction a waiver. Create evidence/handoff with exact source artifacts/hashes, limitations and the proposed task boundary.

resource: Local read-only artifact analysis only; no heavy slot and no GamePC access.
forbidden_regions: tracked RTL, firmware, QSF, SDC, IP, tests, policy, task ledger or expected results
GamePC, Quartus, JTAG, FPGA configuration, terminal, Flash/JIC/EPCQ, reset or power
treating programmer success alone as full candidate functional acceptance
message suppression, evidence deletion or hiding the T-031 retry-count deviation

dispatch.monitoring: event-driven; one-hour maximum wait; no frequent polling

result.historical_contract: T-021 actual success used exact SOF/programmer evidence followed by candidate-unique BOOT/READY, not an executed post-program candidate-hash gate
result.T031_audit: candidate programmer=3 PASS transactions and golden programmer=3 PASS transactions; retries recorded as a process deviation; no terminal evidence
result.contract: exact SHA-bound SOF plus one successful programmer transaction plus candidate-unique pre-input LCVEX25 startup; programmer or cached jtag hash alone is insufficient
result.next_board_limits: candidate program=1, live terminal=1, golden restore=1, internal retries=0
